now.title: VisionQuest
now.text: In episode 3, F.R.I.D.A.Y. lives in Vision's mind with Tony's other AIs and helps Vision protect Tommy.

proposed.text: In episode 3, F.R.I.D.A.Y. lives in Vision's mind with Tony's other AIs, works to repair him after Paladin's attack, and finds an intruder linking into his mind.

changes.evidence: In VisionQuest episode 3 ('Reboot'), Vision is fleeing with Tommy after Paladin's adamantium rounds leave him critically hurt; the AIs in his Mindspace work to stabilize his failing systems, F.R.I.D.A.Y. uses one of J.A.R.V.I.S.'s methods to repair him, and at the end she discovers another synthezoid (Butcherbird) has connected to Vision's neural network during his reboot. She does not help protect Tommy in this episode; Tommy is the one who helps revive Vision.
